kurz: Salt slices, let them sit, pat them dry. They lose water, soak up less oil and brown better.
bild_im_kopf: Like wringing out a sponge beforehand so it does not soak up so much oil later.
was_passiert: Salt draws water out of the cells. The aubergine's air pockets collapse in the process, so it soaks up less oil when fried. The drier surface browns faster.
schritte: Salt generously and leave in a sieve for 20–30 minutes.
Pat off the water that comes out.
